sentences.en: (2) For a tourist group that is composed of people in a special trade, the local guide must try to acquaint himself with the knowledge and technical terms of their specialty.

sentences.questionEn: In what ways must the local guide make preparations for conducting a group in respect to
sentences.questionZh: 地陪上团前应如何做好语言和知识方面的准备？
sentences.en: (3) In addition, the local guide must be well prepared for questions about hot talks of the town, important news at home and abroad and any other subjects that the tourists may be interested in.

sentences.questionEn: In what ways must the local guide make preparations for conducting a group in respect to
sentences.questionZh: 地陪上团前应如何做好语言和知识方面的准备？
sentences.en: (4) If the local guide himself is new to the places to be visited by the group, he must try his best to familiarize himself with them beforehand.

sentences.questionEn: While meeting an inbound group in the airport or train station, how can the local guide make
sentences.questionZh: 接待入境团的地陪在机场或车站接团时，应如何确认某一团队是否是自己应接的团？
sentences.en: sure that the group he is meeting is the very one he should meet?
sentences.zh: （1）应问清该团来自哪个国家（地区）、客源地组团社和国内组团社的名称、领队和全陪的 姓名等； （2）如该团没有领队和全陪，地陪应与该团成员核对团名、团号、国别及游客人数、姓名 并核实其主要行程。

sentences.questionEn: While meeting an inbound group in the airport or train station, how can the local guide make
sentences.questionZh: 接待入境团的地陪在机场或车站接团时，应如何确认某一团队是否是自己应接的团？
sentences.en: The local guide must make certain that: (1) The local guide must ask the tourists what country they come from and inquire of them about the names of their tour escort and their national guide, the name of the travel service in their own country and the name of the tour organizer travel service in China.

sentences.questionEn: While meeting an inbound group in the airport or train station, how can the local guide make
sentences.questionZh: 接待入境团的地陪在机场或车站接团时，应如何确认某一团队是否是自己应接的团？
sentences.en: (2) If the group has neither escort nor national guide, he must inquire of the tourists their nationality, the name or code of the group, and the number of people and the main itinerary of the group.

sentences.questionEn: Try to make a welcome speech to a tourist group in the name of a local guide. The following
sentences.questionZh: 试以地陪的身份对旅行团致一段规范的欢迎辞。
sentences.en: points should be included: (1) According the tourists a welcome for their visit to your city on behalf of your travel service, the driver and yourself; (2) Introducing yourself and the travel service you work for; (3) Introducing the driver; (4) Expressing your willingness and desire to render good services to the tourists; (5) Wishing the tourists a pleasant stay in your city.
sentences.zh: 要求包括以下内容： （1）代表所在接待社、司机及本人欢迎客人的光临； （2）介绍自己的姓名及所属单位； （3）介绍司机； （4）表示提供优质服务的诚挚愿望； （5）预祝游客旅游愉快。

sentences.questionEn: What things should be mentioned when the local guide is telling the tourists the general
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在向游客作当地概况介绍时，应包括哪些内容？
sentences.en: conditions of his city?
sentences.zh: （1）介绍当地的概况应包括气候条件、人口、行政区域划分、社会生活、文化传统、土特 产品、历史沿革等； （2）还要适时介绍当地的市貌、发展概况及沿途经过的重要建筑物、街道等。

sentences.questionEn: What things should be mentioned when the local guide is telling the tourists the general
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在向游客作当地概况介绍时，应包括哪些内容？
sentences.en: When giving the tourists a general idea of the city, the local guide should refer to such things as: (1) The city’s climate, population, administrative divisions, social life, cultural tradition, special products and its history.

sentences.questionEn: What things should be mentioned when the local guide is telling the tourists the general
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在向游客作当地概况介绍时，应包括哪些内容？
sentences.en: (2) In the meantime, he should take occasion to tell the tourists something about the city’s developments in economy and municipal construction as well as the streets and important buildings along the way.

sentences.questionEn: How can the local guide keep in touch with the tourists after the group has checked in at the
sentences.questionZh: 在游客入住酒店后，地陪应如何保持与旅行团的联系？
sentences.en: hotel?
sentences.zh: 地陪要掌握领队、全陪和团员的房间号，并将与自己联系的办法如房间号、电话号码等告诉 全陪和领队，以便有事时尽快联系。

sentences.questionEn: How can the local guide keep in touch with the tourists after the group has checked in at the
sentences.questionZh: 在游客入住酒店后，地陪应如何保持与旅行团的联系？
sentences.en: The local guide must write down all the room numbers of the group, especially those of the tour escort and the national guide.

sentences.questionEn: How can the local guide keep in touch with the tourists after the group has checked in at the
sentences.questionZh: 在游客入住酒店后，地陪应如何保持与旅行团的联系？
sentences.en: He should also tell the tour escort and the national guide his own room number and telephone number so that they may reach each other in time of need.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if the tour escort or the national guide proposed to make a
sentences.questionZh: 当领队或全陪对接待计划提出小的修改意见或增加新的游览项目时，地陪应如何应对？
sentences.en: minor change or add a new item to the sightseeing program?
sentences.zh: （1）及时向旅行社有关部门反映，对合理又可行的要求，应尽量予以满足； （2）对需要加收费用的项目，地陪要事先向领队或游客讲明，按有关规定收取费用； （3）对确实无法满足的要求，地陪要详细解释，耐心说服。

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if the tour escort or the national guide proposed to make a
sentences.questionZh: 当领队或全陪对接待计划提出小的修改意见或增加新的游览项目时，地陪应如何应对？
sentences.en: (1) The local guide should report the matter to the travel service leadership and try his best to arrange it if their proposal is reasonable and feasible.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if the tour escort or the national guide proposed to make a
sentences.questionZh: 当领队或全陪对接待计划提出小的修改意见或增加新的游览项目时，地陪应如何应对？
sentences.en: (2) If an extra charge must be made for the added item, he must let them know in advance and must collect the money at the set price.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if the tour escort or the national guide proposed to make a
sentences.questionZh: 当领队或全陪对接待计划提出小的修改意见或增加新的游览项目时，地陪应如何应对？
sentences.en: (3) If it is difficult or impossible to meet their demand, he must give them a clear explanation and patiently persuade them to follow the original program.

sentences.questionEn: In what way should the local guide collect the checked luggage of the group that has just
sentences.questionZh: 有托运行李的旅行团抵达本地后，地陪应如何清点行李？
sentences.en: arrived?
sentences.zh: （1）地陪应协助本团游客将行李集中放在指定位置，提醒游客检查自己的行李物品是否完整 无损； （2）与领队、全陪核对行李无误后，移交给行李员，双方办好交接手续； （3）若有行李未到或破损，地陪应协助当事人到有关交通部门办理行李丢失或赔偿申报手续。

sentences.questionEn: In what way should the local guide collect the checked luggage of the group that has just
sentences.questionZh: 有托运行李的旅行团抵达本地后，地陪应如何清点行李？
sentences.en: (1) When the group has arrived, the local guide should help the tourists get their luggage together at a designated place and remind them to check and make sure that their bags are all in good condition.

sentences.questionEn: In what way should the local guide collect the checked luggage of the group that has just
sentences.questionZh: 有托运行李的旅行团抵达本地后，地陪应如何清点行李？
sentences.en: (2) Together with the tour escort and the national guide, he should count to get the right number of pieces and then hand them over to the luggage man of the local travel service through necessary procedures.

sentences.questionEn: In what way should the local guide collect the checked luggage of the group that has just
sentences.questionZh: 有托运行李的旅行团抵达本地后，地陪应如何清点行李？
sentences.en: (3) If something is missing or damaged, he should help the owner to approach departments concerned to report and register the loss or claim compensation for the damaged.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide remind the tourists to do when they are going to leave the bus for
sentences.questionZh: 游客下车参观景点前，地陪应向他们交代哪些内容？
sentences.en: sightseeing?
sentences.zh: 地陪要讲清并提醒游客记住旅行车的型号、颜色、标志、车号，以及停车地点、开车的时间 等。

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide remind the tourists to do when they are going to leave the bus for
sentences.questionZh: 游客下车参观景点前，地陪应向他们交代哪些内容？
sentences.en: On this occasion the local guide should advise the tourists to remember the model, color, number and special sign of the tour bus.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide remind the tourists to do when they are going to leave the bus for
sentences.questionZh: 游客下车参观景点前，地陪应向他们交代哪些内容？
sentences.en: He should also tell them where the bus will be parking and what time they will be leaving for the next destination.

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: certificates of the tour escort and other tourists?
sentences.zh: （1）一般情况下，地陪不应保管团队的旅行证件。如需使用游客的证件办理某项手续时， 应在用完后立即归还游客； （2）在离站前一天，地陪要检查自己的物品，看是否保留有游客的证件、票据等，若有应 立即归还，当面点清； （3）某些酒店在旅行团入住时，要求领队将其证件留在总台，地陪应在旅行团离店时提醒 领队取回自己的证件； （4）入境团出境前，要提醒游客准备好护照和申报单，以便交边检站和海关检查。

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: (1) Under normal conditions, the local guide should not keep the travel certificates of the tourists.

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: If he needs to use them, he must return them to the tourists as soon as he has finished using them.

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: (2) On the day before the group leaves, the local guide should check his own belongings to see if he has kept any of the group’s passports or other papers and, if any, should hand them back personally to their owners without delay.

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: (3) Some hotels request that the tour escort should leave his passport at the reception department when the group checks in at the hotel.

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: In this case, the local guide must remind the tour escort to take it back when the group checks out to leave the hotel.

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: (4) When a foreign group is going to leave the country, the local guide should remind the tourists to check and make sure that they have their passports and Customs declaration forms readily available for examinations by the Customs and immigration officers.

sentences.questionEn: What are the main points that need the local guide’s attention in regard to the travel
sentences.questionZh: 在领队和游客的证件保管、使用方面，地陪应做哪些工作？
sentences.en: (They must not pack them into their bags to be checked.)

sentences.questionEn: How can the tour guide ensure that the tourists will not get lost?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何预防游客走失？
sentences.en: To prevent the tourists from getting lost, the tour guide must do a good job of the following: (1) The local guide must request that the tourists should bear in mind the names of the local travel service and the hotel and the number of the tour bus, that they must not wander too far away from the group while it’s moving on, and that they must not come back to the hotel too late if they leave the group to stay behind or when they go out of the hotel by themselves.
sentences.zh: （1）导游人员要提醒游客：记住地接社名称、车号、酒店名称，团队行进时不要离团太远， 在外逗留或自行外出时回酒店不要太晚。 （2）在参观游览过程中，经常向游客预报行程并讲清用餐时间、地点，游览线路，集合时间、 地点以及停车地点。 （3）时刻与游客在一起，经常清点人数。 （4）地陪、全陪、领队密切配合；地陪在前领路，全陪、领队做好断后工作。 （5）地陪要以精彩的讲解吸引游客。

sentences.questionEn: How can the tour guide ensure that the tourists will not get lost?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何预防游客走失？
sentences.en: (2) During the sightseeing tour, the local guide should often announce the itinerary of the day so as to keep the tourists informed of such things as the route of the tour, the time and place for meals, the time and place to assemble and the parking place of the tour bus.

sentences.questionEn: How can the tour guide ensure that the tourists will not get lost?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何预防游客走失？
sentences.en: (3) The tour guide should stay together with the tourists all the time and frequently count the number of people in the group.

sentences.questionEn: How can the tour guide ensure that the tourists will not get lost?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何预防游客走失？
sentences.en: (4) The local guide, the national guide and the tour escort must closely cooperate in their work.

sentences.questionEn: How can the tour guide ensure that the tourists will not get lost?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何预防游客走失？
sentences.en: While the local guide leads the way for the group, the national guide and the tour escort should bring up the rear.

sentences.questionEn: How can the tour guide ensure that the tourists will not get lost?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何预防游客走失？
sentences.en: (5) The local guide’s explanatory speeches must be interesting enough to attract the tourists’ attention so that they would not wander away from the group.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide tell the tourists when the group is going to check in at the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在旅行团入住饭店时，应向游客交代什么？
sentences.en: When the group is going to check in at the hotel, the local guide should tell the tourists where they can change their money, how to find the place for entertainment and the locations of the stores, public toilets and the Chinese and Western-food restaurants and so on.
sentences.zh: 地陪应向全团介绍酒店内的外币兑换处、中西餐厅、娱乐场所、商场、公共洗手间等设施的 位置，并讲清入住的注意事项。

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide tell the tourists when the group is going to check in at the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在旅行团入住饭店时，应向游客交代什么？
sentences.en: In addition, he should also make the tourists acquainted with matters deserving their attention while staying in the hotel.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do before, during and after meals in order that meals for the
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在团队用餐前、用餐时和用餐后要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: group could be properly arranged?
sentences.zh: （1）用餐前，地陪要提前对用餐地点、时间、人数、标准、特殊要求等逐一核实并确认； （2）用餐时，地陪应巡视团队的用餐情况一两次，解答游客在用餐中提出的问题，并监督、 检查餐厅的服务质量; （3）用餐后，地陪要严格按实际用餐人数、标准与餐厅结账。

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do before, during and after meals in order that meals for the
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在团队用餐前、用餐时和用餐后要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: (1) Before meals, the local guide must check such things as place, time, number of diners and per capita price for the meals and particular requests of the tourists, and try to make sure that all these have been properly arranged.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do before, during and after meals in order that meals for the
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在团队用餐前、用餐时和用餐后要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: (2) When the tourists are having their meals, the local guide should go, once or twice, around the dining-room to answer questions of the tourists and to supervise the service of the restaurant.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do before, during and after meals in order that meals for the
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在团队用餐前、用餐时和用餐后要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: (3) After meals, the local guide must settle the bills strictly in accordance with the fixed per capita charge and the actual number of diners.

sentences.questionEn: What is the right way for the local guide to deal with the recreational activity that is included
sentences.questionZh: 地陪应怎样安排好旅游团计划内和计划外的文娱活动？
sentences.en: or excluded in the group’s scheduled program?
sentences.zh: （1）如果是计划内的文娱节目，地陪应陪同前往，并介绍情况; （2）如果是计划外的文娱活动（如游客提出自费观看文娱演出或参加某种娱乐活动），地陪一般 应予以协助，但通常不陪同前往； （3）当游客要去大型娱乐场所活动时，地陪应提醒游客不要走散，并留意其动向和周围的环境， 以防不测。

sentences.questionEn: What is the right way for the local guide to deal with the recreational activity that is included
sentences.questionZh: 地陪应怎样安排好旅游团计划内和计划外的文娱活动？
sentences.en: (1) If the activity is included in the group’s itinerary, the local guide is duty-bound to accompany the tourists to attend it and make them acquainted with the performance.

sentences.questionEn: What is the right way for the local guide to deal with the recreational activity that is included
sentences.questionZh: 地陪应怎样安排好旅游团计划内和计划外的文娱活动？
sentences.en: (2) If it is not included in the group’s itinerary, for instance, if the tourists ask to watch a theatrical performance at their own expense, the local guide can help them with such things as buying admission tickets or hiring a taxi but usually he has no occasion to keep them company.

sentences.questionEn: What is the right way for the local guide to deal with the recreational activity that is included
sentences.questionZh: 地陪应怎样安排好旅游团计划内和计划外的文娱活动？
sentences.en: (3) When the group is staying in a large place of recreation, the local guide should advise the tourists against separating themselves from the group.

sentences.questionEn: What is the right way for the local guide to deal with the recreational activity that is included
sentences.questionZh: 地陪应怎样安排好旅游团计划内和计划外的文娱活动？
sentences.en: He must also keep an eye on the movement of the tourists and the condition of the surroundings so as to be prepared for any contingency.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the group is going to leave the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团离开当地饭店前，地陪要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: (1) When the group is about to leave the hotel, the local guide must collect all the heavy bags of the tourists for consignment if they have any.
sentences.zh: （1）集中交运行李。如旅行团有行李须交付托运，地陪要按商定好的时间与领队、全陪、行 李员一起清点行李并检查行李的包扎情况。 （2）办理退房手续。如无特殊情况，地陪应在中午 12 点前办理退房手续; （3）集合登车。离开饭店前，地陪要询问游客与饭店的帐目是否结清，请游客将房间钥匙交 回服务台；集合游客上车，等游客入座后，要仔细清点实到人数，提醒游客检查有无遗漏物品。

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the group is going to leave the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团离开当地饭店前，地陪要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: And, together with the tour escort, the national guide and the luggage man, he should check the number of pieces and the packing condition of the luggage at an appointed time.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the group is going to leave the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团离开当地饭店前，地陪要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: (2) Under normal conditions, he should go through the check-out formalities before 12:00 noon.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the group is going to leave the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团离开当地饭店前，地陪要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: (3) Before the group leaves, he should remind the tourists to pay the hotel bills and return the keys to the reception desk in case they should forget.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the group is going to leave the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团离开当地饭店前，地陪要做好哪些工作？
sentences.en: When the tourists are all seated in the bus, he should carefully count the number of people and remind the tourists to check and make sure that they have nothing left behind in the hotel.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the sightseeing tour of the day is coming to an end and
sentences.questionZh: 在结束一天的游览返回饭店的途中，地陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: the tourists are all seated in the bus on the way back to the hotel?
sentences.zh: （1）返回饭店的途中，地陪应回顾当天参观、游览的内容，必要时可补充讲解并回答游客的 问询; （2）如旅行车不从原路返回饭店，地陪应作沿途风光导游; （3）在游客下车前，地陪要预报晚上或次日的活动日程、出发时间、集合地点等; （4）提醒游客带好随身物品; （5）地陪要先下车，照顾游客下车，并向他们道别。

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the sightseeing tour of the day is coming to an end and
sentences.questionZh: 在结束一天的游览返回饭店的途中，地陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (1) On this occasion, the local guide should review the sightseeing tour of the day, tell the tourists more in detail about what they have seen and answer their questions, if they have any.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the sightseeing tour of the day is coming to an end and
sentences.questionZh: 在结束一天的游览返回饭店的途中，地陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (2) If the tour bus is not going the same way back to the hotel as it came out, the local guide should take occasion to acquaint the tourists with the sights passed by.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the sightseeing tour of the day is coming to an end and
sentences.questionZh: 在结束一天的游览返回饭店的途中，地陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (3) Before the tourists get off the bus, the local guide should announce the program for the evening and for the next day, and tell them the time to leave and the place to meet.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the sightseeing tour of the day is coming to an end and
sentences.questionZh: 在结束一天的游览返回饭店的途中，地陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (4) On arriving at the hotel, the local guide should remind the tourists to take all their belongings with them when they leave the bus.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do when the sightseeing tour of the day is coming to an end and
sentences.questionZh: 在结束一天的游览返回饭店的途中，地陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (5) When the bus is parked, the local guide should be the first to get off the bus and stand at the door to say good-bye to the tourists while watching them getting off the bus.

sentences.questionEn: What are the three “outposts” that a tourist group has to pass through before it enters a
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团进入旅游目的地国家时，需要过哪“三关”？
sentences.en: foreign country?
sentences.zh: 就是要办理有关入境的三项检查手续：卫生检疫、证件查验、海关检查。

sentences.questionEn: What are the three “outposts” that a tourist group has to pass through before it enters a
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团进入旅游目的地国家时，需要过哪“三关”？
sentences.en: The three “outposts” refer to the check-posts of the three authority organs of the destination country, that is, the Customs, immigration and quarantine check-posts stationed at the city of entry to the destination country.

sentences.questionEn: What are the three “outposts” that a tourist group has to pass through before it enters a
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团进入旅游目的地国家时，需要过哪“三关”？
sentences.en: (This means that, before the group is allowed to enter the country, it must go through all the checking and examination formalities of the Customs, immigration and quarantine authorities of the destination country.)

sentences.questionEn: How long before departure time must tourist groups arrive at the airport, train-station or pier
sentences.questionZh: 为了避免误机（车、船）事故的发生，导游送团时在时间安排上要注意什么？
sentences.en: so as to ensure that they will not lose the flight, train or ship？ In order that the tourist group will not risk losing the flight, train or ship, the tour guide must manage to ensure that his group will arrive at the airport, train station or pier at an earliest possible time.
sentences.zh: 导游团送团时，应确保团队在飞机或车、船离站前抵达机场或车站、码头，具体要求是： （1）乘坐出境航班或去沿海城市的航班，提前 2 小时; （2）乘坐国内航班提前 1.5 小时； （3）乘坐火车、轮船提前 1 小时。

sentences.questionEn: How long before departure time must tourist groups arrive at the airport, train-station or pier
sentences.questionZh: 为了避免误机（车、船）事故的发生，导游送团时在时间安排上要注意什么？
sentences.en: Specific requirements are: (1) If the flight is an international flight or is destined for a coastal city, the group must get to the airport 2 hours before departure time; (2) For domestic flight, 90 minutes before departure time; (3) For train and ship, one hour before departure time.

sentences.questionEn: On what principle must the national guide insist when discussing the sightseeing program
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在与地陪商定日程时，应掌握怎样的原则？
sentences.en: with the local guide?
sentences.zh: （1）如果地陪修改日程，全陪应坚持“调整顺序可以，减少项目不行”的原则，必要时报告组 团社； （2）地陪推荐自费项目时，全陪要征求全体旅游团成员的意见。

sentences.questionEn: On what principle must the national guide insist when discussing the sightseeing program
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在与地陪商定日程时，应掌握怎样的原则？
sentences.en: The national guide’s duty is to ensure that the tour itinerary worked out by the tour organizer will be fully implemented by the tour executor travel service.

sentences.questionEn: On what principle must the national guide insist when discussing the sightseeing program
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在与地陪商定日程时，应掌握怎样的原则？
sentences.en: So, … (1) If the local guide suggests a change in the itinerary, the national guide must insist that the order of visits to places of tourist interest can be changed but none of the items in the program can be omitted.

sentences.questionEn: On what principle must the national guide insist when discussing the sightseeing program
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在与地陪商定日程时，应掌握怎样的原则？
sentences.en: When occasion requires, he should report the matter to the tour organizer travel service.

sentences.questionEn: On what principle must the national guide insist when discussing the sightseeing program
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在与地陪商定日程时，应掌握怎样的原则？
sentences.en: (2) In case the local guide proposes to add an item with extra charge, the national guide must get the common consent of the group before he agrees to the proposal.

sentences.questionEn: What is the national guide required to do whenever the group arrives at a destination city?
sentences.questionZh: 每到一个旅游目的地，全陪都要做好哪些工作?
sentences.en: Every time the group arrives at a destination city, the national guide is duty-bound … (1) To acquaint the local guide with things in the group so as to help him with his work; (2) To supervise the service of the local travel company and, if he thinks necessary, put forward some suggestions; (3) To take care of the tourists to guard against any possible accidents and to solve problems arising from accidents, if any; (4) To give advice to the tourists when they are shopping; (5) And, to make contacts with people concerned, especially with the travel service in the next destination city, so that the group may travel smoothly.
sentences.zh: （1）全陪应向地陪通报旅游团的情况，并协助地陪工作； （2）监督各地服务质量，酌情提出改进意见和建议； （3）保护游客的安全，预防和处理各种事故； （4）为游客当好购物顾问； （5）做好与下一站的联络工作。

sentences.questionEn: What role does a national guide play in the tour activities, and what are his responsibilities?
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团的旅游活动中充当什么角色？承担什么责任?
sentences.en: The national guide is the representative of the tour organizer travel service.
sentences.zh: 全陪是组团社的代表，应自始至终参与旅游团队的全程活动，负责旅行团行程中各环节的衔 接，监督接待计划的实施，协调领队、地陪、司机等接待人员之间的关系。

sentences.questionEn: What role does a national guide play in the tour activities, and what are his responsibilities?
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团的旅游活动中充当什么角色？承担什么责任?
sentences.en: He must join the group throughout journey and take part in all its activities.

sentences.questionEn: What role does a national guide play in the tour activities, and what are his responsibilities?
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团的旅游活动中充当什么角色？承担什么责任?
sentences.en: His duty is to make the whole trip of the group well connected between destination cities along the route of the journey, to supervise the service of the local travel companies to ensure that the set itinerary for the group will be carried into effect, and to coordinate and harmonize the relations between the tour escort, the local guide and the driver.

sentences.questionEn: In what ways must the national guide supervise the shopping arrangements for the group
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团购物时，应如何发挥监督与指导作用？
sentences.en: and how should he help the tourists to do shopping?
sentences.zh: （1）如地陪安排购物次数过多或延长购物时间，全陪要及时交涉； （2）购物时，要提醒游客注意商品的质量和价格，谨防假货或以次充好； （3）入境团游客购买贵重物品特别是文物时，要提醒其保管好发票以备出海关时查验；在他 们购买中成药、中药材时，要向其讲清中国海关的有关规定。

sentences.questionEn: In what ways must the national guide supervise the shopping arrangements for the group
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团购物时，应如何发挥监督与指导作用？
sentences.en: (1) If the local guide has arranged too many times for the group to do shopping and if shopping has taken up too much of the time for sightseeing, the national guide must advise the local guide against the arrangements.

sentences.questionEn: In what ways must the national guide supervise the shopping arrangements for the group
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团购物时，应如何发挥监督与指导作用？
sentences.en: (2) When the tourists are shopping, the national guide should advise them to examine the price and quality of the articles they are thinking of buying so that they should not buy any inferior goods or fake products.

sentences.questionEn: In what ways must the national guide supervise the shopping arrangements for the group
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团购物时，应如何发挥监督与指导作用？
sentences.en: (3) When some foreign tourists have bought something valuable, especially antiques, the national guide should remind them to keep the receipts for Customs examination.

sentences.questionEn: In what ways must the national guide supervise the shopping arrangements for the group
sentences.questionZh: 全陪在旅行团购物时，应如何发挥监督与指导作用？
sentences.en: For purchase of ready-prepared Chinese medicines or Chinese medicinal materials, he should tell them the relevant regulations of the Chinese Customs.

sentences.questionEn: What is the national guide required to do when the group has arrived in the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅行团抵达酒店时，全陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (1) When the group has arrived in the hotel, the national guide must take an active part in the work of checking in at the hotel.
sentences.zh: （1）积极主动地协助领队办理旅游团的入住手续； （2）请领队分配住房，全陪要掌握住房分配名单，并与领队互通房号以便联系； （3）热情引导游客进入房间； （4）如地陪不住酒店，全陪要负起全责，照顾好旅行团； （5）掌握酒店前台的电话号码以及与地陪联系的办法，以备必要时联系。

sentences.questionEn: What is the national guide required to do when the group has arrived in the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅行团抵达酒店时，全陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (2) While the responsibility of assigning rooms to the group members is usually undertaken by the tour escort, the national guide must keep a rooming list of the group.

sentences.questionEn: What is the national guide required to do when the group has arrived in the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅行团抵达酒店时，全陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: He should also exchange room numbers with the tour escort so that they may reach each other in case of need.

sentences.questionEn: What is the national guide required to do when the group has arrived in the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅行团抵达酒店时，全陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (3) When the tourists have got their room numbers, the national guide should show them the way to their rooms.

sentences.questionEn: What is the national guide required to do when the group has arrived in the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅行团抵达酒店时，全陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (4) If the local guide is not staying in the hotel for the night, the national guide must take full responsibility of taking care of the group.

sentences.questionEn: What is the national guide required to do when the group has arrived in the hotel?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅行团抵达酒店时，全陪有哪些工作要做？
sentences.en: (5) In addition, the national guide should note down the telephone number of the hotel reception and must inquire of the local guide about the way of getting in touch with him in case of emergency.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do in order to supervise the service quality of the local travel
sentences.questionZh: 在监督各地服务质量方面，全陪应采取怎样的措施？
sentences.en: agencies?
sentences.zh: （1）若某地的活动安排与前几站有明显重复，全陪应建议地陪作必要的调整； （2）若对当地接待工作有意见（如住房、餐饮、车辆达不到原协议的标准﹑地陪擅自减少取 消旅游项目或收费加点以及过多安排购物等），要诚恳地向地陪提出。 （3）如仍未改善，则直接向接待社提出，必要时向组团社报告。

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do in order to supervise the service quality of the local travel
sentences.questionZh: 在监督各地服务质量方面，全陪应采取怎样的措施？
sentences.en: (1) If the sightseeing program in a city is much the same as those in the preceding cities, the national guide must suggest that the local guide should make some changes.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do in order to supervise the service quality of the local travel
sentences.questionZh: 在监督各地服务质量方面，全陪应采取怎样的措施？
sentences.en: (2) He must frankly give his opinions to the local guide if he has any complaint about the service of the local tour company; for example, if the meals, hotel or tour bus arranged by the local tour company do not come up to the agreed standards, if the local guide deliberately cancel an item on the sightseeing program in an attempt to add another item for extra charge before he is authorized to do so, or if shopping has taken up too much of the time for sightseeing.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do in order to supervise the service quality of the local travel
sentences.questionZh: 在监督各地服务质量方面，全陪应采取怎样的措施？
sentences.en: (3) If his efforts of talking to the local guide have no effect, he should refer the problem directly to the local travel service leadership or report the matter to the tour organizer if necessary. 26．What should the national guide of a foreign tourist group do when the group is about to leave the country?

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do in order to supervise the service quality of the local travel
sentences.questionZh: 在监督各地服务质量方面，全陪应采取怎样的措施？
sentences.en: (1) When a foreign tourist group’s trip to our country is coming to an end and the group is going to leave the hotel for the airport or train station, the national guide should remind the tourists to check and make sure that they have all their belongings with them and have their travel certificates within easy reach.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do in order to supervise the service quality of the local travel
sentences.questionZh: 在监督各地服务质量方面，全陪应采取怎样的措施？
sentences.en: (2) On the way to the airport or train station, he should earnestly ask the tourists for their comments or complaints on the tour.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do in order to supervise the service quality of the local travel
sentences.questionZh: 在监督各地服务质量方面，全陪应采取怎样的措施？
sentences.en: (3) When the bus is arriving at the airport or train station, he should make a farewell speech to give thanks to the tourists for their cooperation and understanding and express his expectation for their return.

sentences.questionEn: Try to make a farewell speech to the tourists in the name of a national guide. The following
sentences.questionZh: 试以全陪的身份对旅行团致一段欢送辞。
sentences.en: points should be included in the speech: (1) Reviewing the trip of the group and giving your thanks to the tourists for their cooperation.
sentences.zh: 要求包括以下内容： （1）回顾旅游活动，感谢大家的合作； （2）表达友谊和惜别之情； （3）诚恳征求游客对接待工作的意见和建议； （4）若旅游活动中有不顺利或旅游服务有不尽如人意之处，导游人员可借此机会再次向游客赔 礼道歉； （5）表达美好的祝愿。

sentences.questionEn: Try to make a farewell speech to the tourists in the name of a national guide. The following
sentences.questionZh: 试以全陪的身份对旅行团致一段欢送辞。
sentences.en: (2) Expressing your friendliness to the tourists and your reluctance and regret to part with them.

sentences.questionEn: Try to make a farewell speech to the tourists in the name of a national guide. The following
sentences.questionZh: 试以全陪的身份对旅行团致一段欢送辞。
sentences.en: (3) Inviting suggestions and opinions from the tourists.

sentences.questionEn: Try to make a farewell speech to the tourists in the name of a national guide. The following
sentences.questionZh: 试以全陪的身份对旅行团致一段欢送辞。
sentences.en: (4) Offering apologies to the tourists if things on the tour were not going smoothly or if the tourists are not satisfied with the service they have received.

sentences.questionEn: Try to make a farewell speech to the tourists in the name of a national guide. The following
sentences.questionZh: 试以全陪的身份对旅行团致一段欢送辞。
sentences.en: (5) Expressing your good wishes to the tourists

sentences.questionEn: In what manner must tour guides behave before the excessive demands and critical remarks of
sentences.questionZh: 面对游客的苛求和挑剔，导游人员应如何应对？
sentences.en: the tourists?
sentences.zh: （1）一要认真倾听，不要没有听完就指责游客的要求不合理或胡乱解释； （2）二要微笑对待，不要一听到不顺耳的话就表示反感还恶语相向； （3）三要耐心解释，对合理的但不可能办到的要求，要耐心地、实事求是地进行解释，不要 以“办不到”一口拒绝。

sentences.questionEn: In what manner must tour guides behave before the excessive demands and critical remarks of
sentences.questionZh: 面对游客的苛求和挑剔，导游人员应如何应对？
sentences.en: Before the excessive demands and critical remarks of the tourists, the tour guide must keep calm and behave reasonably and politely.

sentences.questionEn: In what manner must tour guides behave before the excessive demands and critical remarks of
sentences.questionZh: 面对游客的苛求和挑剔，导游人员应如何应对？
sentences.en: (1) First, they should have the patience to listen to the tourists and must not interrupt them to assert that their demands are unreasonable, or just find an excuse for refusal.

sentences.questionEn: In what manner must tour guides behave before the excessive demands and critical remarks of
sentences.questionZh: 面对游客的苛求和挑剔，导游人员应如何应对？
sentences.en: (2) Second, they should keep smiling all the time and must not talk back to the tourists or become impatient the moment he hears something unpleasing to the ear.

sentences.questionEn: In what manner must tour guides behave before the excessive demands and critical remarks of
sentences.questionZh: 面对游客的苛求和挑剔，导游人员应如何应对？
sentences.en: (3) Third, they should have the patience to explain to the tourists why it is impossible to satisfy their demands even if they are reasonable, and must not flatly refuse them simply by saying “No, it is impossible!”

sentences.questionEn: What kind of relationship should be maintained between the tour guides and the
sentences.questionZh: 在带团的全过程中，导游人员与游客之间应保持怎样的人际关系？
sentences.en: tourists?
sentences.zh: （1）导游人员要记住自己是主人。要有主人热情好客的态度，要有主人的度量，对游客礼 让三分。 （2）导游人员不要与游客过分亲近；不介入旅行团内部的矛盾和纠纷，不在游客之间搬弄 是非；对待游客要一视同仁，不厚此薄彼。

sentences.questionEn: What kind of relationship should be maintained between the tour guides and the
sentences.questionZh: 在带团的全过程中，导游人员与游客之间应保持怎样的人际关系？
sentences.en: (1) The tour guides must bear in mind that they are the host and must behave as such. they should have the manner of being hospitable, courteous and thoughtful towards the guests.

sentences.questionEn: What kind of relationship should be maintained between the tour guides and the
sentences.questionZh: 在带团的全过程中，导游人员与游客之间应保持怎样的人际关系？
sentences.en: (2) But the tour guides must not keep much too close a relation with the tourists.

sentences.questionEn: What kind of relationship should be maintained between the tour guides and the
sentences.questionZh: 在带团的全过程中，导游人员与游客之间应保持怎样的人际关系？
sentences.en: They should treat people equally and must not favor one and be prejudiced against the other.

sentences.questionEn: What kind of relationship should be maintained between the tour guides and the
sentences.questionZh: 在带团的全过程中，导游人员与游客之间应保持怎样的人际关系？
sentences.en: They must never tell tales among the tourists, nor must he get involved in the disputes between them.

sentences.questionEn: How are tour guides to assist foreign tourists to meet with people in China?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何协助、安排入境游客的会见活动？
sentences.en: When the foreign tourists in a group of a special trade are scheduled to meet with their Chinese counterparts, the tour guide is duty-bound to act as an interpreter.
sentences.zh: （1）当游客（主要是专业旅行团）会见中国方面的同行或负责人，必要时导游员可充当翻译； 若另有翻译，导游员可在一旁静听。 （2）若游客要会见在华亲友，导游员应协助安排，一般情况下没有充当翻译的义务。

sentences.questionEn: How are tour guides to assist foreign tourists to meet with people in China?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何协助、安排入境游客的会见活动？
sentences.en: If another interpreter is appointed, he can just sit aside and listen quietly.

sentences.questionEn: How are tour guides to assist foreign tourists to meet with people in China?
sentences.questionZh: 导游人员应如何协助、安排入境游客的会见活动？
sentences.en: In case the tourists want to meet with their friends or relatives in China, the tour guide can help them with arrangements, but usually he is not necessarily responsible for interpretation.

sentences.questionEn: What must the local guide do before setting out to meet the tourist group in order that the tour
sentences.questionZh: 地陪在接团前应如何落实旅游车辆？
sentences.en: bus for the group may be properly arranged?
sentences.zh: （1）与车队联系，确认车型、车牌号和司机姓名及电话； （2）与司机确定接头地点并告知活动日程和具体时间安排。

sentences.en: (3) To make amends for my error, I should make full use of the time to fulfill the sightseeing program so as to get understandings from the tourists.

sentences.questionEn: What must the tour guide do in case the group has failed to catch the flight?
sentences.questionZh: 一旦旅行团发生误机事故，导游人员应如何处理？
sentences.en: In case the group has lost the flight, the tour guide must do the following: (1) He must report the matter immediately to the leaders of his travel service to ask for help.
sentences.zh: （1）导游人员应立即向旅行社领导及有关部门报告,请求协助； （2）尽快与机场联系，安排游客尽快离开本站； （3）稳定游客的情绪，安排好食宿、游览等事宜； （4）及时通知下一站，对日程作相应的调整； （5）向游客赔礼道歉； （6）写出事故报告，查清事故原因和责任，责任者应承担经济损失。

sentences.questionEn: What must the tour guide do in case the group has failed to catch the flight?

sentences.en: (2) He must consult the airline and try to arrange another flight for the group to leave at an earliest possible time.

sentences.questionEn: What must the tour guide do in case the group has failed to catch the flight?

sentences.en: (3) He must have the meals, hotel accommodations and sightseeing well arranged for the tourists while they are detained so as to relieve them from anxiety.

sentences.en: (5) And, of course, he must make an apology to the tourists for the mishap.

sentences.en: (6) Finally, he must write out a report to find out the cause of the event and to ascertain where the responsibility lies so that the wrong-doer should answer for the losses incurred.

sentences.en: lost his passport while the group is sightseeing in Guangzhou?
sentences.zh: 18．某旅行团在广州游览时，团内一位美籍华人不慎丢失了自己的证件，经多方寻找仍无下落。 要协助失主补办护照及签证,办证所需费用由游客自理。程序是： （1）先由旅行社出具遗失证明并让失主准备照片； （2）由失主本人持证明去广州市公安局（外国人出入境管理处）报失并开具证明； （3）持公安局的证明去美国驻广州领事馆，申请补办美国护照； （4）领到新护照后，再去广州市公安局补办中国签证。

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if a Chinese American (an American citizen of Chinese origin)
sentences.questionZh: 作为地陪，你应当如何处理？
sentences.en: In this case, the local guide must help him apply for a new American passport and a new visa to China.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if a Chinese American (an American citizen of Chinese origin)

sentences.en: The expense incurred from this must be borne by the person concerned.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if a Chinese American (an American citizen of Chinese origin)

sentences.en: (1) To help him apply for a new American passport, the local guide must first get a certificate of loss from the local travel service and ask the tourist to get his photos ready for use.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if a Chinese American (an American citizen of Chinese origin)

sentences.en: (2) With the certificate of loss from the travel service, the tourist must personally report the case to (the Foreigners’ Exit and Entry Affairs Management Department of) the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau and ask for an official certificate of loss.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if a Chinese American (an American citizen of Chinese origin)

sentences.en: (3) With the certificate of loss from the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau, the tourist should go to the American Consulate in Guangzhou to apply for a new American passport.

sentences.questionEn: What should the local guide do if a Chinese American (an American citizen of Chinese origin)
sentences.questionZh: 作为地陪，你应当如何处理？
sentences.en: (4) Then, with the new passport, he should go to the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau again to apply for a new visa to China.

sentences.en: In this case, the local guide must help him apply for a new Chinese passport and a new visa to the United States.

sentences.en: (1) To apply for a new Chinese passport, the tourist must first get his photos ready for use.

sentences.en: (2) And the local guide must get a certificate of loss from his travel service.

sentences.en: (3) With the certificate of loss from the travel service, the tourist must go personally to the Public Security Bureau of Guangdong Province to report the loss and apply for a new Chinese passport.

sentences.en: (4) Then, with the new passport, the tourist should apply to the American Consulate in Guangzhou for an entry visa to the United States.

sentences.questionEn: A native Chinese in a tourist group lost his identity card and the group is going to travel by

sentences.en: What should the tour guide do to deal with the case?

sentences.questionZh: 游人员应如何处理此事？
sentences.en: (1) The tour guide should first ask the local travel service to write out a letter of certification to prove the loss.

sentences.questionEn: A native Chinese in a tourist group lost his identity card and the group is going to travel by
sentences.questionZh: 游人员应如何处理此事？
sentences.en: (2) With the letter of certification written by the local travel service, the tourist must personally report the case to the local public security bureau and ask them to issue a certificate to prove his identity.

sentences.en: (3) If he failed to get the certificate from the public security bureau, the tour guide should arrange for him to travel by other means of transport.

sentences.en: The travel fares should be paid by the said tourist and final accounts will be settled after the tour according to the stipulations of the tour contract.

sentences.zh: 21．一位外国游客的行李在来华途中丢失，在到达我国机场时才发觉。地陪应如何协助他处理 （1）带失主到机场失物登记处，办理行李丢失和认领手续； （2）在本地游览期间，地陪要不时打电话询问寻找行李情况； （3）一时找不回行李，要协助失主购置必要的生活用品； （4）若行李确实丢失，应协助失主向有关航空公司索赔。

sentences.questionZh: 此事？
sentences.en: (1) In this case, the local guide should take the tourist to the Lost Luggage Registration Office of the airport to report and register the loss.

sentences.questionEn: When a foreign tourist group arrived in the airport in China, a tourist in the group discovered

sentences.en: (2) While the group is visiting the local city, the local guide should often telephone the airport to inquire about the result of their search for the luggage.

sentences.en: (3) When the luggage is not found for the moment, the local guide should help the tourist to buy his daily necessities.

sentences.en: (4) If eventually they give it up for lost, the local guide should help the tourist to claim compensation from the airline.

sentences.questionZh: 某旅行团表示对某一地的餐饮强烈不满时，导游员在该团离开此地前应采取什么补救措施?
sentences.en: been served during their stay in a city?
sentences.zh: （1）认真听取客人的意见，并做好记录。 （2）向该地旅行社及饭店通报情况，并提出改进意见；若有可能，可让其向游客道歉，并采 取必要的补救措施。 （3）分析了解客人的餐饮习惯并通知下一站旅行社，使其提前做好这方面的特别服务。

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if the tourists are greatly discontented with the meals they’ve
sentences.questionZh: 某旅行团表示对某一地的餐饮强烈不满时，导游员在该团离开此地前应采取什么补救措施?
sentences.en: (1) The tour guide should earnestly listen to and note down the opinions and complaints of the tourists.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if the tourists are greatly discontented with the meals they’ve
sentences.questionZh: 某旅行团表示对某一地的餐饮强烈不满时，导游员在该团离开此地前应采取什么补救措施?
sentences.en: (2) And report the matter to the local travel service and the hotel or restaurants so that they would make improvement or take possible remedial measures to apologize to the tourists.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if the tourists are greatly discontented with the meals they’ve
sentences.questionZh: 某旅行团表示对某一地的餐饮强烈不满时，导游员在该团离开此地前应采取什么补救措施?
sentences.en: (3) Also, he should make a study of people’s likes and dislikes in food and, before the group leaves, inform the travel service in the next city about what’s happened in the group so that they could have the group’s meals purposely prepared in advance.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do to take care of the tourists who are liable to carsick, airsick
sentences.questionZh: 全陪对旅行团中会晕车、晕机或晕船的客人，应作何关照？
sentences.en: or seasick?
sentences.zh: （1）提醒晕车、晕机、晕船者，旅行前要不饱食并服用适当药物（最好是使用自备药，并提 醒游客留意药品的禁忌，许多晕车药均不适合青光眼患者）； （2）尽可能安排其坐在较为平衡的座位上； （3）长途旅行中游客晕机（车、船），导游人员可请乘务员协助照顾。

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do to take care of the tourists who are liable to carsick, airsick
sentences.questionZh: 全陪对旅行团中会晕车、晕机或晕船的客人，应作何关照？
sentences.en: (1) To take good care of the tourists who are liable to carsickness, airsickness or seasickness, the national guide should warn them not to eat too much before traveling.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do to take care of the tourists who are liable to carsick, airsick
sentences.questionZh: 全陪对旅行团中会晕车、晕机或晕船的客人，应作何关照？
sentences.en: He should remind them to take a right dose of carsickness preventive, but must warn them of the contraindications of the drug because many carsickness preventives are harmful to health, especially for glaucoma sufferers.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do to take care of the tourists who are liable to carsick, airsick
sentences.questionZh: 全陪对旅行团中会晕车、晕机或晕船的客人，应作何关照？
sentences.en: (2) When assigning seats on the bus or plane, those at less shaky positions should be reserved for them.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do to take care of the tourists who are liable to carsick, airsick
sentences.questionZh: 全陪对旅行团中会晕车、晕机或晕船的客人，应作何关照？
sentences.en: (3) When the group is traveling long distance by plane or train, the national guide should ask the attendants to help look after them.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a tourist in the group fainted away for heatstroke?
sentences.questionZh: 团中有一客人中暑晕倒，导游人员应采取什么措施？
sentences.en: (1) If someone fainted away for heatstroke, the tour guide should help him lie down on his back at a cool and shady place and unbutton his collar and loosen his waist-belt.
sentences.zh: （1）应置患者于阴凉处，平躺，解开衣领，放松裤带； （2）可能时让其饮用含盐饮料或服用必要的防暑药物，对发烧者要用冷水或酒精擦身散热； （3）症状缓解后，让其静坐（卧）休息； （4）严重中暑者在作必要处理后，立即送医院治疗。

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a tourist in the group fainted away for heatstroke?
sentences.questionZh: 团中有一客人中暑晕倒，导游人员应采取什么措施？
sentences.en: (2) Then, he should feed him some salted drinks and heatstroke preventive if they are available.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a tourist in the group fainted away for heatstroke?
sentences.questionZh: 团中有一客人中暑晕倒，导游人员应采取什么措施？
sentences.en: If the patient has a fever, he should wipe his body with alcohol or cold water so as to disperse the excessive heat from his body.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a tourist in the group fainted away for heatstroke?
sentences.questionZh: 团中有一客人中暑晕倒，导游人员应采取什么措施？
sentences.en: (3) When the patient’s condition has improved, he can just let him sit or lie down to rest for a while.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a tourist in the group fainted away for heatstroke?
sentences.questionZh: 团中有一客人中暑晕倒，导游人员应采取什么措施？
sentences.en: (4) But, if his condition is still serious, he must take him to the hospital for further treatment.

sentences.questionEn: What measure should the tour guide take in order to prevent tourists from personal and
sentences.questionZh: 旅游团入住饭店时，导游人员要采取什么措施，防止游客人身及财物遭受损害?
sentences.en: property damage while they are staying in the hotel?
sentences.zh: （1）入住饭店后，导游人员应建议游客将贵重财物存放在饭店保险柜中，不要随身携带或放 在房间内； （2）提醒游客出入房间锁好门，不要将房号随便告诉陌生人；不要让陌生人或自称饭店维修 工等人员随便进入房间，尤其是夜间不可贸然开门，以防止意外；不要与私人兑换外币。

sentences.questionEn: What measure should the tour guide take in order to prevent tourists from personal and
sentences.questionZh: 旅游团入住饭店时，导游人员要采取什么措施，防止游客人身及财物遭受损害?
sentences.en: (1) That they must lodge their valuables in the safes of the hotel instead of carrying them on their persons or just leaving them about in the hotel rooms.

sentences.questionEn: What measure should the tour guide take in order to prevent tourists from personal and
sentences.questionZh: 旅游团入住饭店时，导游人员要采取什么措施，防止游客人身及财物遭受损害?
sentences.en: (2) And that they should always leave their doors fastened when going in and out of their rooms and must not allow strangers or people who claim to be hotel workers (say, repairmen) to come into their rooms, especially at night.

sentences.questionEn: What measure should the tour guide take in order to prevent tourists from personal and
sentences.questionZh: 旅游团入住饭店时，导游人员要采取什么措施，防止游客人身及财物遭受损害?
sentences.en: In addition, the tour guide should advise the tourists against changing their money with private money-changers so that they should not be fooled and cheated by evil people.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do in order to guard against traffic accidents during the tour?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅游过程中，为了预防出现交通事故，导游员应做好哪些工作?
sentences.en: In order to avoid traffic accidents, the tour guide should do as follows: (1) Before setting out to meet the group, the tour guide should ask the driver to check and make sure that the bus is in good condition or request that the bus be changed if any breakdown has not been fixed.
sentences.zh: （1）出团前，提醒司机检查车辆，发现隐患及时排除或换车。 （2）安排行程要留有余地，不因赶行程而催促司机超速或违章行车。 （3）在天气、交通、路况不好的情况下，行车时要提醒司机注意安全。 （4）禁止非本车的司机开车。 （5）提醒司机不要饮酒。

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do in order to guard against traffic accidents during the tour?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅游过程中，为了预防出现交通事故，导游员应做好哪些工作?
sentences.en: (2) When the tour guide is planning the sightseeing program, he must leave adequate margins of time to allow for traffic jams and other possible delays so that the driver should not be pressed to drive over speed limit to hurry on with the journey.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do in order to guard against traffic accidents during the tour?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅游过程中，为了预防出现交通事故，导游员应做好哪些工作?
sentences.en: (3) When driving in bad weather or on rough or heavily trafficked roads, the tour guide should warn the driver not to drive rashly.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do in order to guard against traffic accidents during the tour?
sentences.questionZh: 在旅游过程中，为了预防出现交通事故，导游员应做好哪些工作?
sentences.en: (4) When occasion requires, the tour guide should advise the driver against allowing other drivers to drive his bus and … (5) When the driver is at work, stop him from having alcoholic drinks.

sentences.questionEn: What must the tour guide do in order that the tourists should not be poisoned by food?
sentences.questionZh: 导游员应如何防止旅行团发生食物中毒事故？
sentences.en: To guard against the accident of food-poisoning, (1) The tour guide must reserve meals for the group in the restaurants that are designated for tourist groups and … (2) Warn the tourists not to buy any food from street peddlers.
sentences.zh: （1）必须安排旅行团在定点餐厅用餐； （2）提醒游客不要在小摊购买食物； （3）用餐时发现食物不洁或变质，应立即要求更换。

sentences.questionEn: What must the tour guide do in order that the tourists should not be poisoned by food?
sentences.questionZh: 导游员应如何防止旅行团发生食物中毒事故？
sentences.en: (3) If the food served in the restaurant is found turning bad or unclean, the tour guide must ask to change it without delay.

sentences.zh: 由地接社出具证明，让失主携带能证明其身份的证件、资料及照片，向遗失地的市级公安局 出入境签证处报失，核实后发给一次性有效的出入境通行证。

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a tourist from Taiwan reported that his Travel Permit for

sentences.en: In this case, the tour guide should have a letter of certification written by the local travel service to prove the loss and ask the tourist to have his photo taken.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a tourist from Taiwan reported that his Travel Permit for
sentences.questionZh: 旅行团中，一位来自台湾的客人发现自己的旅行证件不见了。地陪应如何处理？
sentences.en: With the letter written by the local travel service and the identity certificate and photos of the tourist, the tour guide should take him to report the loss to the local security bureau at the municipal level, which will verify his identity and give him a provisional Entry and Exit Permit that is valid just on one occasion.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do if someone in the group failed to get his luggage back from
sentences.questionZh: 如游客在机场行李输送带前找不到自己的行李，全陪应怎么做？
sentences.en: the luggage conveyer belt in the airport?
sentences.zh: （1）带失主到失物登记处办理行李丢失和认领手续。由失主出示机票和行李牌，填写丢失行 李登记表； （2）立即向旅行社领导汇报，请其安排有关部门和人员与机场、上一站旅行社、航空公司等 单位联系，积极寻找。

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do if someone in the group failed to get his luggage back from
sentences.questionZh: 如游客在机场行李输送带前找不到自己的行李，全陪应怎么做？
sentences.en: (1) The national guide should take the tourist to the Lost and Found Office of the airport to register the loss.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do if someone in the group failed to get his luggage back from
sentences.questionZh: 如游客在机场行李输送带前找不到自己的行李，全陪应怎么做？
sentences.en: The tourist must produce his air-ticket and luggage claim and fill out a Lost Luggage Registration Form.

sentences.questionEn: What should the national guide do if someone in the group failed to get his luggage back from

sentences.en: (2) Then, the national guide should report the matter to the local travel service leadership so that they may contact the airport, the airline and the travel service in the preceding city for help.

sentences.questionZh: 旅游团中，一对夫妇要求在客房自行用餐，导游人员怎样处置？

sentences.zh: （1）导游人员要耐心解释，并请领队劝其与团队一起用餐； （2）如游客仍坚持要在客房自行用餐，导游人员可告知其直接与餐厅联系送餐，但餐费自理， 而且不能退还综合服务费。

sentences.questionEn: What can the tour guide do if a couple of husband and wife in the group asked to have their
sentences.questionZh: 旅游团中，一对夫妇要求在客房自行用餐，导游人员怎样处置？
sentences.en: (1) In this case the tour guide can ask the tour escort to help persuade them to have their meal with the group.

sentences.questionEn: What can the tour guide do if a couple of husband and wife in the group asked to have their
sentences.questionZh: 旅游团中，一对夫妇要求在客房自行用餐，导游人员怎样处置？
sentences.en: (2) If they still insist in having their meal in their room, the tour guide can tell them that they can order a room service with the hotel restaurant at their own expense and that the service charge they have paid for the tour is not to be refunded.

sentences.en: and stay behind in the hotel for a rest because he is not feeling well?
sentences.zh: （1）请其自便，不勉强其随团活动； （2）通知餐厅安排午餐，必要时为其提供送餐服务； （3）告知客人饭店医务室的联系办法； （4）告知房间服务员注意照顾客人； （5）游览回来后，应去询问该客人情况，以示关心。

sentences.questionZh: 游客因身体不适，想单独留在饭店休息而不随团活动时，怎么办?
sentences.en: When someone in the group is sick and is not able to join the group for sightseeing, (1) The tour guide should let him stay behind in the hotel for a rest.

sentences.questionZh: 游客因身体不适，想单独留在饭店休息而不随团活动时，怎么办?

sentences.en: (2) He should reserve a lunch for him in the hotel restaurant or arrange a room service for him if necessary.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if someone in the group intends to give up the sightseeing tour

sentences.en: (3) He should tell the tourist the way of getting in touch with the doctor in the hotel and … (4) Ask the hotel house-keeper to help take care of him (5) When back from sightseeing, the tour guide should go to see him and inquire after his health so as to show concern for him.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a foreign tourist in the group insists that, for a certain reason,
sentences.questionZh: 有一外国游客，因有要事要求提前离团回国，导游员应如何处理？
sentences.en: (1) Usually, such request of the tourists should be granted, but the unused part of the service charge included in the travel fare will not be refunded or will be partly refunded according to the stipulations of the tourist agreement.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a foreign tourist in the group insists that, for a certain reason,

sentences.en: The tour guide must immediately report the matter to people concerned in the local travel service, who will consult the domestic tour organizer travel service.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a foreign tourist in the group insists that, for a certain reason,

sentences.en: (2) With the consent of the domestic tour organizer travel service, the tour guide should help the tourist with such things as separating his visa from the group’s collective visa, booking his home-bound transport ticket and going through other formalities for leaving the group.

sentences.questionEn: What should the tour guide do if a foreign tourist in the group insists that, for a certain reason,

sentences.en: All the expense incurred from these must be borne by the tourist himself.

sentences.questionEn: While a group was sightseeing, a photography-lover in the group said that he didn’t want to

sentences.en: How would you respond if you were the local guide of the group?

sentences.questionEn: While a group was sightseeing, a photography-lover in the group said that he didn’t want to

sentences.en: I would agree to his request if conditions permitted, say, the place was not crowded and public order was good, but meanwhile I must remind him of the time and place to meet and the number of the tour bus or, to be on the safe side, give him a note marking clear the time and place to meet, the number of the tour bus and the name and telephone number of the hotel.

sentences.zh: 导游人员应积极协助，必要时陪同前往。

sentences.questionEn: A tourist told the tour guide that he wanted to exchange his purchase with the shop. Should
sentences.questionZh: 有位游客在商店购买商品后要求退换，导游员应否予以帮助？
sentences.en: The tour guide is duty-bound to help him and should accompany him to the shop for the replacement if necessary.

sentences.questionEn: Supposing a group is traveling by train and a tourist suddenly fell seriously ill. What must the

sentences.en: In this case, the tour guide must ask the head of the train crew to help find a doctor on the train to give him first aid treatment.

sentences.questionEn: Supposing a group is traveling by train and a tourist suddenly fell seriously ill. What must the
